perf(marketing): optimize hero backdrops to WebP, stop shipping 90MB of PNGs

The raw Kimi v20 photos were 6-7.6MB each and all public/ files ship to
dist unconditionally — the build had ballooned to 99MB (About hero alone
pulled a 7.6MB PNG, killing LCP).

- Convert the 4 used hero backdrops + logo to small WebP via sharp
  (bg_features 126KB, bg_security 113KB, bg_contact 29KB,
   scene_family_modern 168KB, gcsc_logo_circle 26KB)
- Point page backdrops at the .webp variants
- Move the heavy unused v20 originals to _design-assets/v20/ (gitignored)
  so they stay available locally for the future v20 source integration
- dist: 99MB -> 8.5MB; devDep sharp

Gates: tsc clean, eslint 0 errors, brand-polish + legal-claims pass, build OK.
